item.name: 01-card-lifecycle

urlencoded.description: manual = hold only. don't capture yet

request.description:
1. create a payment request of type manual (authorize only). the server (Y's server) uses tge secret key to place a hold
    
2. the server then hands off the client secret to the user's app over TLS encrypted connection while the server only keeps the payment ID in the DB
    
3. then the user enters the card and does the 3ds if needed on the user's app. this uses the publishable key (static merchant app key) and the client secret from the user's app memory (the generated key needed fot this one payment)
    
4. stripe then sends the result to the server using a webhook or a lookup with the secret key and payment ID
